title: bvh-motion-tools
pitch: Load, retarget, and blend BVH motions with a clean Python API.
keyFeatures: BVH parser to skeleton + per-joint transforms
Retargeting between skeletons with joint mapping
Motion trimming, looping, and time-warp resampling
Blend and concatenate clips with root-motion options
targetUsers: Python developers preprocessing motion-capture BVH files for character animation, ML, or game pipelines.
